modelDescription: The Tikka T3 Hunter is designed for the shooter who wants a rifle with both top performance as well as a classic style and feel. The T3 Hunter offers an extensive caliber selection for hunting and sport-shooting purposes. It is built with traditional principles and modern innovation, providing you with a new level of accuracy, reliability, and enjoyment. 1 MOA accuracy is guaranteed by Tikka.
